subject: Finalizing payment rails for BlueHarbor — ACH remittance tag + PO mapping
body:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
To: Dana Ruiz <payments@blueharborlogistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finalizing payment rails for BlueHarbor — ACH remittance tag + PO mapping

Hi Dana —

Thanks again for sending the onboarding packet yesterday. We have two quick asks before we flip the live flag on payments from Redwood: an ACH remit-field example and the PO->remit mapping we should expect on your side.

What we need from you to finish onboarding today:
- Confirm the exact remittance field you will populate for ACH (we prefer a single text field we can map into our AP reference; example: "REMIT_NOTE: PO123456 / INV7890")
- Confirm whether your reconciliation team reads the entire ACH "addenda" field or just the remittance line on the payment.
- Confirm wire instructions are acceptable for one-off urgent payouts (we will primarily use ACH).

Attached: W9 + wiring instructions you sent — we copied the file to our vendor record. If you can reply with one sample ACH file line or screenshot of the values your bank provides, that will speed this up.

Goal: map "PO number" on our PO to a single consumable remittance token on your side so our finance team can auto-apply payments.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0198

---

From: Dana Ruiz <payments@blueharborlogistics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: BlueHarbor AP <ap@blueharborlogistics.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing payment rails for BlueHarbor — ACH remittance tag + PO mapping

Hi Tessa,

Thanks — happy to confirm. BlueHarbor will appear on ACH files like this (ACH CCD + Addenda):
- ACH addenda (X12-like free text) will contain: "RBW:PO-<PONUMBER>|INV-<INVOICE>#|REF:<REFERENCE>"
- Our AR system parses the addenda looking for the "PO-" token and then "INV-" as fallback.

Example addenda text we see:
RBW:PO-43219|INV-7890|REF:RH-202804

We do read the addenda field for CCD entries — please include PO- prefix and we will match it automatically.

Wire instructions are attached in the PDF as you already have. For urgent wires please use the bank reference field to include the same RBW token above.

Attached: BlueHarbor_W9_and_Wire_Instructions.pdf

—Dana Ruiz
Senior Payments Specialist
BlueHarbor Logistics
payments@blueharborlogistics.com

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Dana Ruiz <payments@blueharborlogistics.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing payment rails for BlueHarbor — ACH remittance tag + PO mapping

Perfect — thanks for the example, Dana. A couple follow-ups from FinOps: 
- What character limit do you enforce on the addenda text? We currently truncate to 80 characters in our legacy pipeline and want to ensure the RBW token doesn't get cut.
- Tell us the preferred tag for electronic remittance advice (some vendors send an extra XML/EDI file via SFTP). Do you accept an SFTP remit file, or do you only rely on ACH addenda?

Ben — happy to loop you for final authorization once Dana confirms length/alternate remit channel.

Marissa
VP, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

---

From: Dana Ruiz <payments@blueharborlogistics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: BlueHarbor AP <ap@blueharborlogistics.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 14:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing payment rails for BlueHarbor — ACH remittance tag + PO mapping

Marissa —

We typically allow 140 chars in the addenda. If you must truncate, prioritize keeping the RBW:PO- token and the invoice number. We can accept an optional SFTP remit file (CSV) placed in our secure bucket if you want structured remittance — include columns: PO, Invoice, Amount, Payment Date, Redwood_Ref.

Attached: ACH_Mandate_Signed.jpg (signature page).

If you give us the test ACH payment details we can confirm the addenda appears in our system and ack it back to you.

Best,
Dana

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Dana Ruiz <payments@blueharborlogistics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing payment rails for BlueHarbor — ACH remittance tag + PO mapping

Dana — thanks for confirming the format and the 140-char ceiling. We ran a quick test through our sandbox ACH generator this morning and included addenda exactly like your example (RBW:PO-43219|INV-7890|REF:RH-202804). Can you confirm receipt and whether the PO matched on your end?

Jonas — posting this to the vendor record and setting live effective 2028-05-20 once BlueHarbor ACKs the test.

Dana (cc): please reply with a quick "ACK" if the addenda matched and the PO applied. If we don't hear back by EOD Monday we'll keep payments on hold and send a second test.

Thanks all —
Ben Carter
Senior Finance Manager | Redwood Inference

> On Fri, May 18, 2028 at 18:05:00 -04:00 Dana Ruiz <payments@blueharborlogistics.com> wrote:
> 
> Ben — ACK. Test payment received, addenda parsed, PO-43219 matched to invoice 7890 and applied.
> 
> We will go live for Redwood with your default remittance token (RBW:PO-<PO># pattern).
> 
> —Dana
